title: ericameria nauseosa var. graveolens
intro: Ericameria nauseosa var. graveolens, commonly known as Piney Greasewood or Piney Rubber Rabbitbrush, is a plant species native to the western United States and Canada. This shrub is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Piney Greasewood include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and supporting respiratory health, while its therapeutic actions include acting as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Piney Greasewood include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
